profile.headline: Geologist and Programmer
profile.summary: Highly proficient and results-driven software engineer with 10 years of experience architecting, developing, and depolying complex real-time data acquisition and monitoring platforms. Expertise in automated telemetry analysis, distributed ground station network monitoring, and real-time alerting systems using Python, C++, and Rust. Proven ability to translate complex data streams into reliable and scalable operational software systems for mission-critical infrastructure.

positions.title: Geologist (Software Engineer)
positions.description:
- Develop Telemetry Monitoring Suite, Falcon2, and integrate Web Services for Albuquerque Seismological Laboratory for use by field engineers, support personnel, and quality control teams.

- Document, troubleshoot, test, enhance user experience, and maintain programs as Lead Developer for Telemetry Monitoring Suite, Falcon2, and Web Services.

- Monitor telemetry and state-of-health metrics for stations in the Global Seismographic Network (GSN), the Advanced National Seismic System (ANSS), the N4 Network, and more; a total of 450+ stations actively monitored. Identify anomalies and perform troubleshooting to resolve problems.

- Assist scientists and field engineers in all field activities including the collection of ground motion data related to earthquake hazards and active faults including preparing and planning for field investigations, assisting senior geologists in collecting field data, and signal processing.

- Check and review notifications from automated processes to monitor data problems, identify issues with missing data or incorrect metadata, or problems with data transfer. Perform troubleshooting and collaborate with field personnel, IT staff, and communications providers to resolve problems.

- Monitor real-time communication links between field stations and the National Earthquake Information Center in Golden, CO.

positions.title: Physical Science Technician
positions.description:
- Monitored communication links between field seismic ground station networks and the National Earthquake Information Center in Golden, CO and the Albuquerque Seismological Laboratory in Kirtland AFB, NM.

- Performed checks of remote seismic station network status for both the Advanced National Seismic System (ANSS) and Global Seismographic Network (GSN) and reviewed results.

- Checked and reviewed notifications from automated processing to monitor data, network, and telemetry anomalies.

- Submitted troubleshooting tickets when problems were discovered and worked collaboratively to try and address telemetry and state-of-health problems.

- Automated processes through Python scripts to help recover data or provide better data integrity as well as ran other automated processes toward these ends.

- Assisted on field maintenance trips to repair non-functioning or under-functioning stations.

- Produced reports on data availability and other data quality metrics as requested.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
Ristra Refuge is a tool designed to facilitate the intake of refugees seeking asylum and the administration of congregant sites.

Ristra Refuge is the website utilizing Ristra which makes use of:
- Django, a high-level Python web framework that encourages rapid development and clean, pragmatic design,
- PostrgreSQL, a powerful, open source object-relational database system with over 30 years of active development that has earned it a strong reputation for reliability, feature robustness, and performance.

positions.title: Sustainable Community Tourism Facilitator
positions.description:
- Was responsible for the administration of $6,800 of joint USAID–Peace Corps funds for community-based project.

- Constructed fuel-efficient wood-burning stoves for 70 families to reduce respiratory ailments from smoke inhalation and deforestation due to reduced firewood consumption.

- Provided leadership with local association as Community Tourism Facilitator and Community Development Leader to increase and diversify alternative income generation.

- Facilitated strategic alliances between community stakeholders and private and non-profit organizations to increase collective ecotourism potential and publicity. In this role curriculum for 300 children and teenagers in trash management, natural resource valuation, and ecological niches was successfully implemented.

- Served on the Gender and Development Committee promoting gender equity in community projects with fellow Peace Corps colleagues.

positions.title: Pharmacy Technician
positions.description:
- Filled and packaged prescriptions for group homes throughout the state of Indiana.

- Delivered medications and made house calls to provide specialized one-on-one customer service.

positions.title: Technical Support Representative
positions.description:
- Designed and provided technical support for Cross Confirm's website.

- Main point of contact for users of Cross Confirm's custom-built software Respect In Sport.
